lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
University library websites are being overwhelmed by bots that are scraping data to train generative AI models, The Canadian Press reports.
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agrees to questioning by U.S. lawmakers, The Associated Press reports.
The City of Ottawa is assessing damage to the Chief William Commanda Bridge after a motorcycle fire on the bridge over the Ottawa River last weekend, The Associated Press reports.
A Liberia-flagged gas tanker sank in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea on Tuesday, according to the Defence Ministry.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
